cases.after: The  Securities  and  Futures  Commission  (SFC)  issues  this  circular  to  inform  licensed  corporations,  SFC-licensed  virtual  asset  service  providers  and  associated  entities  (collectively  referred  to  as  “licensed  firms”)  about  the  logistical  arrangements  for  transitioning  to  the  Joint  Financial  Intelligence  Unit’s  (JFIU)  new  suspicious  transaction  reporting  platform  by  2  February  2026.
cases.before: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issues this circular to inform licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”) about the logistical arrangements for transitioning to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit’s (JFIU) new suspicious transaction reporting platform by 2 February 2026.

cases.after: The  JFIU  has  developed  the  new  platform,  the  Suspicious  Transaction  Report  and  Management  System  2  (STREAMS  2)1,  which  will  replace  the  current  STREAMS  platform.  By  enhancing  system  automation  and  analytical  capabilities,  the  new  platform  increases  the  efficiency  and  effectiveness  of  the  JFIU’s  analysis  and  dissemination  of  financial  intelligence  gathered  from  suspicious  transaction  reports  (STRs)  received.
cases.before: The JFIU has developed the new platform, the Suspicious Transaction Report and Management System 2 (STREAMS 2)1, which will replace the current STREAMS platform. By enhancing system automation and analytical capabilities, the new platform increases the efficiency and effectiveness of the JFIU’s analysis and dissemination of financial intelligence gathered from suspicious transaction reports (STRs) received.

cases.after: Licensed  firms  should  observe  the  JFIU’s  transitional  arrangements  as  set  out  below:
cases.before: Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:

cases.after: (a)  the  JFIU  will  cease  accepting  STR  submissions  via  STREAMS  at  12:00am  on  28  January  2026,  and  will  resume  accepting  STR  submissions  at  9:00am  on  2  February  2026  via  STREAMS  2  (hereafter  referred  to  as  the  “blackout  period  of  STREAMS”);
cases.before: (a)  the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2 (hereafter referred to as the “blackout period of STREAMS”);

cases.after: (b)  for  any  STRs  requiring  urgent  submission  during  the  blackout  period  of  STREAMS,  please  contact  the  JFIU  directly  by  email  (jfiu@police.gov.hk),  phone  at  2866  3366  or  fax  at  2529  4013;
cases.before: (b)  for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

cases.after: (c)  upon  the  launch  of  STREAMS  2  at  9:00am  on  2  February  2026,  the  operation  of  STREAMS  will  be  discontinued.  All  STRs  previously  submitted  through  STREAMS  will  be  migrated  to  STREAMS  2.  Licensed  firms  will  be  able  to  access  these  records  and,  where  applicable,  view  the  consent  status,  via  STREAMS  2;  and
cases.before: (c)  upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued. All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2. Licensed firms will be able to access these records and, where applicable, view the consent status, via STREAMS 2; and

cases.after: (d)  licensed  firms  that  intend  to  submit  STRs  via  the  XML  format  are  required  to  follow  the  XML  schema  provided  separately  by  the  JFIU  and  liaise  with  it  as  soon  as  possible  to  arrange  a  technical  test  to  ensure  a  smooth  transition.
cases.before: (d)  licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.
